Workplace Guidelines
Contact: TriNet HR III or your employer for the number to call. The employer identification number appears on your pay stub.
Job performance is reviewed each year. Poor job performance may lead to disciplinary action, including termination of employment.

Smoke-Free Workplace
An employee who needs a reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources. Member services can help with benefit questions.
Every employee is expected to follow this policy. Questions should be directed to your manager or to Human Resources.

Workplace Violence
The Company provides a safe workplace. Violence, threats or harassment of any kind are not tolerated, and domestic violence that reaches the workplace should be reported.
